fixes.text: Each job spends 1156849810.0 minutes on setup: cache dependencies and build once
"test prod (#) / build": the slowest shard takes 1.44× the median, 26% idle; balance shards by measured time
6% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
Setup on the critical path: 9.2 min of setup in jobs that first wait on others; start it while they wait, and wait only for the step you need
A blocker most jobs wait on: "build-native / build" holds up 66 of 105 jobs, 215.9 job-min past their other needs; shorten it, or let them start setup and wait only for what they need
p90 is 2.3× p50: find what makes the slow runs slow
Jobs wait 189 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
58 cached tasks declare no inputs, such as @next/bundle-analyzer-ui#build: declare each one's inputs, so an edit it doesn't read keeps its cache
nextjs-project#typescript's inputs cover 31060 of 35461 files: narrow them to what it reads
Packages depend on each other in a cycle, turbo-tasks-backend ↔ turbo-tasks-testing: break it, so an edit to one stops reaching the rest
A chain of 7 tasks runs one after another on a cache miss: cut the `dependsOn` edges a task doesn't need
